source_snapshot.procedure: Discover eight current GPU bridge BDFs, disable L1/L0s ASPM per BDF, run the exact AMDXIO PCIe four-point command per link with BER/error/receiver/range parameters, and collect CSV results.
source_snapshot.criteria: Says values should be equal to or below reference, then defines PASS as every lane's Left/Right/Top/Bottom value non-zero and FAIL if any is zero.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL captures margin output but does not resolve the contradictory comparison direction or ASPM restoration.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires authoritative reference direction/combination, exact eight-link/lane map, signed tool, transactional ASPM restore and link/AER recovery.

old_problem: The Criteria combine an equal-to-or-below reference rule with a non-zero screen without defining direction or precedence; applying common margin intuition would alter the source oracle, while ASPM state changes add recovery risk.
disposition_reason: No approved ED rule or generic PCIe standard supplies the project screening reference or explains whether larger/smaller values are better for these AMDXIO outputs. ED-15 prohibits PASS without an approved threshold. The exact BDF mapping and ASPM transaction are parameterizable, but the contradictory PASS/FAIL semantics are irreducible project/SI authority.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row201 all18 XLSX cells and history2806.
Preserved all eight links, exact AMDXIO source parameters, four lane metrics and both conflicting Criteria statements.
Required ASPM baseline/restore and AER/link evidence; no AMDXIO, ASPM or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: PCIe eight-link four-point margin test pending authoritative reference oracle
test_case.purpose: Measure four-point receive margins for every lane on all eight current GPU PCIe links with the source AMDXIO parameters, restore ASPM exactly, and evaluate only with an approved project/SI rule combining reference and non-zero screens.
required_package: Authoritative per-lane/reference comparison direction and precedence with the non-zero screen
Signed AMDXIO binary/version/schema and exact source parameter support
Current BIOS-specific bridge BDF-to-physical-link/lane map for all eight links
Recorded per-BDF ASPM baseline and approved disable/restore commands
Maintenance window, watchdog, AER/link/thermal aborts and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not issue margin or ASPM commands until the oracle and topology are approved. Then discover and bind all eight physical links to current BDFs, record ASPM baseline, disable only L1/L0s on each approved target, run the exact source four-point command per link, collect complete CSV/console outputs, and restore/verify every ASPM state before evaluating each lane with the approved combined rule.
test_case.expected_result: All expected links/lanes produce complete Left/Right/Top/Bottom measurements, every value satisfies the approved reference/non-zero rule, ASPM returns exactly to baseline, and no AER, link-width/speed, GPU or platform regression occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is prohibited until SI authority defines reference direction and its relationship to the non-zero screen. File creation or non-zero values alone cannot override the contradictory Criteria.
safety_gate: AMDXIO margining and ASPM changes require explicit maintenance approval and OOB access.
Rediscover BDFs for the current BIOS and bind them to physical links; never reuse stale BDFs.
Record and restore ASPM per target even after partial failure.
Abort on wrong target, link retrain/drop, AER growth, GPU fault, timeout or restore failure; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Signed acceptance-rule decision and reference table
AMDXIO checksum/version/help/schema and eight-link BDF/lane manifest
Exact per-link commands plus complete CSV/console results
Post-restore ASPM/link/AER/GPU health and lane-by-lane approved-oracle evaluation
test_case.recovery: Stop remaining links on any fault, restore each modified BDF to its recorded ASPM state, preserve AMDXIO/AER/link evidence, verify topology and GPU health, and escalate if restoration fails. Do not rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Equal/below-reference and non-zero-only PASS statements remain an unresolved acceptance conflict.
